generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The contractor should take delivery of used rails specifically 52Kg/Mtr from Indian Railway Authorities. If contractor transports the rails other than 52Kg/Mtr of the said transportation cost will not be paid and other material shall not be used for erection of barricade/ works.
Transportation of calls from railway authorities should not exceed the estimated quantity of rails and if excess quantity rails transported the variation shall not be admitted.
Payment will be calculated on the basis of actual distance of the rails transported up to the maximum presented in the estimate.
Rails quantity mentioned in the weight slip issued by the appropriate authority will be considered for calculation of payment.
Payment will be done which is advantageous to the government and model calculation sheet is shown for ready reference.
The tenderer shall abide by the Rules and regulations of this Department.
In the contract bill the wastage cost of fabrication will be deducted.
The tenderer should maintain the above works during the defective liability period for 5 years.

Contractor should adhere to 1151. (Health Safety Environment) policy applicable for similar projects. Contractor to that extent should submit HSE document defining all the procedure including the policies before excavation of the project.
All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and the reserves the right to verify the documents before approval.

All safety precautions, warming signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity. Contractor should indemnify the client to that extent.

The successful Tenderer shall deliver to the Employer a Security deposit in any of the forms viz Fixed Deposit or Bank Guarantee for an amount equivalent to 5% of the Contract price plus additional security for unbalanced tenders in accordance with the Conditions of Contract.

The quantity of the work may varies depending upon the available of budget grants in case, the quantity of work increases the tenderer should carry out the increased quantity of works on approved tender rates.
Being a wildlife area, all precautionary measures should be taken by the Contractor to conserve the wildlife and protect themselves from any wildlife attacks.
The DCFs/CCF/Conservator of Forests, / Principal Chief Conservator Forests (Wildlife), Bangalore reserves the rights to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons.

This Tender Inviting authority has the rights to do necessary changes in location of Work and Quantity of work. The successful tenderer should be abiding the order passed by this Tender Inviting authority.
The Successful tenderer should perform Third party Inspection at his own cost and & submit all quality reports/test reports time to time.
The tenderer should arrange the transportation facilities to the labourers for the works at their cost with the prior approval of concerned Range Forest Officer/ ACFs.
Another terms and Conditions as per Tender Document.
Upload Documents as per Annexure A enclosed as Tender Document.
All the conditions mentioned in the tender notification and tender documents are all applicable
